agenda_items.title: System Migration Project Status Review
agenda_items.summary: Ahmad Faizal opened the review of the ongoing system migration project. The migration involves three phases: database migration, application layer migration, and user acceptance testing, targeting completion by end of Q1. Key challenge is data mapping between old and new schemas. The new system supports mobile approval for leave applications. Parallel-run payroll integration testing will run for at least two pay cycles before full cutover, with two engineers specifically allocated for this.

agenda_items.title: Budget Approval for System Migration
agenda_items.summary: Siti Nabilah presented the total projected migration cost of RM 240,000, covering licensing fees, infrastructure upgrade, and professional services. The largest component is cloud infrastructure at RM 120,000 for the first year. The vendor agreed to a phased payment structure: 40% upfront, 30% at go-live, and 30% at three months post-go-live. All attendees agreed to proceed with this structure. The decision was formalised by Ahmad Faizal.

formal_decisions.description: Projek migrasi sistem akan diteruskan dengan struktur pembayaran berperingkat seperti yang dibentangkan oleh Siti Nabilah, dengan jumlah kos keseluruhan RM 240,000.
formal_decisions.decision_english: The system migration project will proceed with the phased payment structure as presented by Siti Nabilah, at a total cost of RM 240,000.
